title: Choose the visual world for Nexora Web
question: The roll assigned The High-Speed Transit Terminal. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Transit Terminal
options.thesis: Fast, highly-converted digital presence delivered like a premium express service.
options.viewport: A departure board aesthetic guiding the user immediately to the 'solicitar orçamento' action.
options.risk: Might feel too utilitarian if the typography isn't razor sharp.

raised.raise: Adopts the amber-on-black discipline and high-contrast typography for unmissable CTAs.

options.label: The Architect's Section
options.thesis: Nexora as a premium, sunlit gallery space focusing entirely on the finished product.
options.viewport: Clean, spaced-out sections scrolling like an architectural draft coming to life.
options.case: Fuses beautifully: sells the 'premium' feel perfectly, but risks feeling a bit too slow/artistic for small businesses wanting quick results.
options.risk: Too much whitespace might make the R$ 497 price point feel disconnected.

canonCard.label: The SaaS Standard
canonCard.thesis: The classic, reliable landing page formula every competitor uses.
canonCard.viewport: Standard hero, 3-column features, and a 3-tier pricing table at the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other generic digital agencies.
